newsitem.title: FRANCE: 1998 French budget to aim to boost tech investment.
newsitem.headline: 1998 French budget to aim to boost tech investment.

text.p: France's 1998 budget law will aim to boost investment by high technology companies, Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn.

Strauss-Kahn told reporters at the presentation of an audit of public finances that with interest rates low and corporations healthy, the outlook for consumer spending was the most important factor in boosting investment.
"But it is not the only one and in a certain number of sectors, notably high technology companies, the 1998 finance law will make its contribution," he said.
